candidate.title: Loeb Fellowship 2027-28, Harvard Graduate School of Design
candidate.organizationName: Harvard Graduate School of Design, The Loeb Fellowship
candidate.description: A mid-career fellowship at Harvard's Graduate School of Design for practitioners who shape the built and natural environment, including urban designers, architects, planners, public artists, developers, journalists and civic and community development leaders. Applicants need at least 8 years of experience in the field. A completed degree is not required, and the programme says experience and leadership count for more than credentials. Fellows step away from major professional roles for the year, live in the Cambridge area, audit at least one GSD course per semester and join weekly seminars and study tours. There is no application fee. The application is online through SlideRoom with three recommendation letters and a resume.
requiredSkills: professional practice in the built or natural environment

additionalRequirements: At least 8 years of practitioner experience in the field.
Not for students or academics on sabbatical; it is for practitioners.
International fellows must obtain a J1 visa and must be eligible for one at the time of selection.

candidate.applicationInstructions: Apply online through SlideRoom with a resume. Three recommenders are asked to submit letters through SlideRoom, due January 12, 2027 at 11:59 ET. Supplemental work samples are optional.
candidate.deadlineQuote: Applications for 2027-2028 are due on Tuesday, January 5, 2027 at 11:59 ET.
candidate.ugandanEligibilityQuote: No, international candidates are encouraged to apply.
